scope: Dock text presentation: headings, body, secondary/disabled labels, category colours, project labels, floating titles and layer names/tooltips.
before: Cold gray/white body labels, low-opacity disabled labels and a category label overprinted behind each layer name.
layer_overlap_fix: Paint one layer name in the compact name region. Retain its category in each control tooltip alongside its original action hint. Model category/slot/current/assignment semantics and swatches unchanged.
floating_header: Dark green title on cream inactive header or framework pale active header; green body uses cream/gold text.
contrast_limits: Ratios describe solid foreground/background colour pairs, not antialiased edge pixels or a broad accessibility certification.

build.command: cargo rustc -p om9-app --bin om9 --target-dir L:/om9-target -j 2 -- -o L:/om9-target/debug/om9-dock-text.exe

tests.command: cargo test -p om9-app --target-dir L:/om9-target -j 2 --test chrome_actions --test shell_docking --test layer_category_palette --test layer_current_and_assign -- --test-threads=1

visual_review: Native screenshots inspected. Gold headings, warm cream body, clearer disabled controls and separated layer names are readable on the green dock. Existing light toolbar/menu and Command colours retained.

public_source_audit.note: Existing private/reference/binary/raster artifacts; no asset added by this text change.

limitations: Formal manual M01-UI acceptance remains pending.
Other chats have concurrent changes in the same files; this receipt covers text presentation and the named tests only.
No model/command semantics or reusable skill business rules changed.
